Here is the address for the listserve. Email them and ask to be included. There are non-ecology people in there, so it isn't ecology centric by any means... although still a pretty strong contigency.

davi...@googlegroups.com


Here is the text from the first email of the quarter:

The results are in, and this quarter we will have D-RUG work sessions at 3-5PM in Wickson 2124.  Our first meeting will be today, with no speaker. (But with cookies!).

Also, based on results from the survey, I'm looking for volunteers to give short presentations on the following topics. Remember, you don't need to be an expert, just have run an analysis that you can show & tell.

Requested topics:

 - Structural equation modeling
 - Vectorization
 - Ordination and Cluster Analysis
 - GLMMs  
 - Parallel processing
 - Structural equation modeling

--
Dr. Iara Lacher


PhD - UC Davis Ecology
MESM - Bren School for Environmental Science and Management
